document.abstract: The launch of ATSC Mobile broadcasting will bring live television to consumers on new personal devices. But mobile broadcasting can be seen as part of a bigger trend towards making all forms of content widely available to consumers on any screen, anytime and anywhere. This paper will examine these major trends, provide some commercial examples of their impact and discuss important future considerations for new technologies and standards.
